candidates.description: Katyusha, Russia's first giant panda cub born at Moscow Zoo, met the public for the first time on Friday local time. Katyusha is now over six months old, and stays in good health. She recently had a routine check-up and weighed 16.5 kilograms and was 100 centimeters long. The giant panda cub was born on August 24, 2023. Katyusha's father and mother are Ru Yi and Ding Ding, which were sent to Russia in 2019 in commemoration of the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Russia.

candidates.description: Sandyhills is a large sandy beach located along the southern coastline of Dumfries and Galloway. The beach slopes gently so the water is shallow and it is a popular beach for paddling and exploring rock pools.. At low tide, vast stretches of sand are exposed which make it an excellent beach for walkers.. This area of coast is renowned for its natural beauty and is a paradise for walkers, especially as dogs are allowed on the beach all year round. To the west, visitors can enjoy the wonderful cliff- top coastal scenery on the way to Rockliffe. To the east, Southerness lighthouse, one of the oldest lighthouses in Scotland is a few miles away along Southerness beach.
